zh.title: 五大人生資產盤點
zh.subtitle: 看見外在的累積，也聽見內在的聲音。
zh.instruction: 請依每題說的時間，選最接近自己實際情況的答案，不用挑看起來最好的選項。這是幫助自己整理近況的工具，不是考試，也不會用分數評斷妳的價值。
zh.privacy: 試填版暫時不需要登入。回答只會留在這個瀏覽器分頁，最多 24 小時，不會傳到會員資料庫，按聯絡按鈕也不會自動傳送。妳可以隨時清除，或列印結果。
zh.note: 這份盤點幫妳整理近況、開啟對話，不是診斷。分段、優先順序和服務建議還在試用調整中；分數不代表個人價值，也不是和別人比較。
zh.about: 更多作答說明與資料保存
zh.timeframe: 情境頻率題只計算該情境實際出現的次數。「不到一半」不包含一次也沒有；「至少一半，但不是每次」不包含每次都是。若近期沒有相關經驗，可回想最近一次類似經驗。若仍找不到合適選項，請記下題號，告訴我們。
zh.missing: 請完成本頁每一題，再繼續。
zh.resultIntro: 先看整體，再看各面向與具體回答。建議是對話的起點，未必能呈現妳的完整處境。
zh.scale: 每側 7–28 分；整體每側 35–140 分。較高表示這次回答呈現較多支持，不代表沒有困難。
zh.priorityNote: 先比較各面向較低的一側，再用兩側合計區分同分。分數接近不代表需要明顯不同；同分並列。
zh.maintain: 目前沒有較低分段的面向，可以維持有效的安排。個別需要仍會在下方列出。
zh.moreT: 有形較高；可留意無形側的具體回答。
zh.moreI: 無形較高；可留意有形側的具體回答。
zh.equal: 兩側分數相同；仍需一起看分段與個別回答。
zh.themeTitle: 依妳的回答，可以先從這裡開始
zh.themeIntro: 先呈現最多三個主題，其餘仍可展開。主題來自內部得分較低的回答，不是對妳的定義。
zh.noService: 可以先與我們聊聊這份結果，再決定下一步。這個主題不自動配對付費服務。
zh.noThemes: 這次沒有內部得分 1 或 2 的回答。可以維持有效的安排，也歡迎聊聊問卷沒有涵蓋的需要。
zh.dailyTitle: 先了解對日常生活的影響
zh.dailyBody: 妳的回答提到身體或情緒狀態會影響必要的日常活動。這些回答會優先保留，不被總分蓋過。若困難持續或影響明顯，請尋求合適的醫療或心理專業協助；盤點與放鬆服務不能取代專業照顧。
zh.contactTitle: 想一起看看這份結果嗎？
zh.contactBody: 問卷未必能呈現妳的完整處境。歡迎告訴我們最近的情況，一起看看這份結果，再討論適合妳的下一步。可以先了解，再決定是否安排服務。
zh.message: 可自行複製或修改這段訊息：
zh.messageText: 你好，我剛完成五大面向盤點，想聊聊我的結果。我最想先了解的是＿＿＿。
zh.contactPrivacy: 按鈕只會開啟官方 LINE，不會自動傳送回答或分數。妳可以自行選擇要分享的內容。
zh.rulesBody: 每題使用自己的選項計分表，內部對應 1–4 分，不依選項位置推算。每側七題相加：7–13 先建立、14–20 持續累積、21–28 較穩定。優先分數＝28－較低側分數；越高越優先。同分比較兩側合計，仍同分並列。只有較低側未滿 21 的面向列為起始優先；個別 1 或 2 分仍保留。主題先看日常活動影響，再看所屬面向的優先分數、兩側合計、最低題分與低分題數；最後同序不代表嚴重度不同。無形與有形的差距用來解讀，不加進優先分數。
zh.serviceNote: 服務建議為初步配對，最多一項。若回答顯示必要支出吃力、取得照顧有困難，或日常活動受影響，本次不自動推薦付費服務，先了解處境。祈願與會員方案不在配對內。
zh.storage: 此瀏覽器無法暫存，請留在本頁完成並列印。
zh.expired: 此分頁的暫存已到期並清除，可以重新開始。
zh.loadError: 盤點暫時無法載入，請重新整理。
zh.accessStep: 妳的回答提到取得照顧有困難。可以先釐清預約、時間、費用、交通或陪同需求，再尋找合適的協助。
zh.awarenessStep: 先試著用一個簡單的詞描述感受，例如難過、緊張或生氣；不必一次說得很準確。
zh.copingStep: 回想一種曾讓情緒稍微緩和的方法或可靠協助，從一個可行的小步驟開始。
zh.pressureStep: 這次的回答提到超出負荷仍繼續。先選一項可以減少、延後或請人協助的安排。
zh.worthStep: 這次的回答提到把失誤視為自己不夠好。先把需要調整的事情，與對整個自己的評價分開。
zh.chapterLength: 這部分有 14 題，分成 4 小頁。
zh.guide: 依每題說的時間，選最接近自己實際情況的答案。
zh.smallGap: 差距僅供描述，不代表有統計上的差異。
zh.supportTitle: 可以與女兒國一起探索的支持
zh.supportIntro: 回答是對話的起點。歡迎與我們聊聊最近的情況，一起看看什麼樣的支持對妳有幫助。
zh.reason_iching: 妳的相關回答顯示，目前在做決定或把計畫付諸行動時可能遇到困難。若想一起探索一個具體問題，可以先了解「易經解困」。
zh.reason_tarot: 妳的相關回答顯示，可能有想進一步釐清的個人問題或方向。若希望透過對話探索，可以先了解「塔囉聊心」。
zh.reason_knife: 妳關於醒來後是否感到休息足夠的回答，顯示休息可能需要多一些關注。若另外想安排身體放鬆體驗，可以先了解「刀式舒壓」。這項建議不是對睡眠問題的評估或治療。
zh.reason_phytoncide: 妳的回答顯示，目前的時間安排可能沒有留下足夠睡眠時間。可以先從保留睡眠時間開始。若另外想安排放鬆體驗，也可以了解「芬多精療癒」；放鬆服務不能取代睡眠。
zh.supportDiscussFirst: 建議先聊聊，再決定是否安排付費服務。妳的回答提到必要支出、取得照顧或日常活動方面的困難；我們希望先了解妳的處境。
zh.supportNoMatch: 這份結果目前沒有特定服務建議。仍歡迎與我們聊聊結果，或問卷未涵蓋的需要。
zh.supportChoice: 這是一個可自由選擇的起點，不代表預約或必須安排服務。歡迎透過下方聯絡方式，先一起確認是否適合妳。
zh.purpose: 生活忙起來，有時很難停下來看看自己。這份盤點會從智慧、美學、健康、財富和文明五個面向，幫妳整理最近的日常做法、想法和感受，看看哪些地方支持著妳，哪些地方需要多照顧一點。
zh.durationNote: 這是目前的預估時間，依妳的閱讀和思考步調而定，不用趕。
zh.outcomeIntro: 妳會看到有形與無形兩張五面向圖表、可以先關注的地方，以及能試試看的小步驟。若有適合的方向，也會提供可自由選擇的服務建議，讓妳和女兒國進一步討論。
zh.whySeventy: 每個面向有 14 題，會從日常做法和內在感受兩邊來看，方便妳把結果和自己的生活經驗放在一起理解。
zh.pauseNote: 想休息一下也可以。回答會在同一個瀏覽器分頁保留最多 24 小時；請保留這個分頁，換裝置無法接著填。
zh.occasionGuide: 請只回想真的遇到這種情況的時候。

en.title: Five Life Assets Assessment
en.subtitle: Explore practical support and inner experience.
en.introTitle: How are things going for you?
en.instruction: Follow the timeframe in each question and choose what best describes your actual experience. You do not need to pick the answer that sounds best. This is a way to reflect on how things are going, and scores do not measure your worth.
en.privacy: Open review version; no login needed. Answers stay in this browser tab for up to 24 hours. They are not sent to a member database or through the contact button. You can clear or print them.
en.note: This is a self-report conversation tool, not a diagnosis. Bands, priorities and service matching are provisional. Scores are not personal worth or a ranking against other people.
en.timeframe: For questions about a particular situation, count only the times that situation came up. “Fewer than half” excludes “never”; “at least half, but not every time” excludes “every time”. If a question does not fit a recent experience, think back to the most recent similar one. If none of the choices fit, note the item number and tell us.
en.missing: Please answer every question on this page.
en.resultIntro: Start with the overview, then each area and its specific answers. Suggestions begin a conversation and may not capture your full circumstances.
en.scale: Each area side: 7–28. Each overall side: 35–140. Higher scores indicate more reported support, not an absence of difficulties.
en.priorityNote: Compare each area’s weaker side, then its combined total for ties. Close scores do not imply distinctly different needs; exact ties share a rank.
en.maintain: No area is in a lower band. Maintain what works; specific needs are still listed below.
en.areaTitle: Each area in its own right
en.moreT: Tangible is higher; consider specific intangible answers.
en.moreI: Intangible is higher; consider specific tangible answers.
en.equal: Both sides match; consider their bands and individual answers.
en.themeTitle: Based on your answers, you could start here
en.themeIntro: Up to three themes appear first; expand to see the rest. Themes come from lower-scored answers, not labels that define you.
en.optional: If you want to explore further
en.noService: You can discuss this result with us before deciding on a next step. This theme has no automatic paid-service match.
en.noThemes: No answers received an internal score of 1 or 2. Keep what works, and feel free to discuss needs the questionnaire did not cover.
en.dailyTitle: First, understand the effects on daily life
en.dailyBody: Your answers mention physical or emotional difficulties affecting essential daily activities. These remain visible regardless of totals. If difficulty persists or substantially affects daily life, seek appropriate medical or mental-health support. This assessment and relaxation services do not replace professional care.
en.contactTitle: Would you like to talk through your results?
en.contactBody: A questionnaire may not capture your full circumstances. Tell us what has been happening, and we can discuss your results and a suitable next step. You can ask first before deciding whether to arrange a service.
en.message: You can copy or edit this message:
en.messageText: Hello, I completed the Five Life Assets Assessment and would like to discuss my results. I would like to start with ____.
en.contactPrivacy: The button only opens official LINE. It does not automatically send answers or scores. You choose what to share.
en.rulesBody: Each item uses its own hidden 1–4 choice key, independent of screen position. Sum seven items per side: 7–13 foundation, 14–20 developing, 21–28 steadier. Priority = 28 minus the weaker side; higher comes first. Ties use the lower combined total, with equal totals tied. Only areas with a weaker side below 21 become initial priorities, but all individual 1/2 answers remain. Themes sort by daily-function effects, contributing-area priority, combined total, lowest answer and lower-answer count; remaining display order is not severity. The tangible–intangible gap informs interpretation without adding priority points.
en.serviceNote: Service matching is provisional, with at most one suggestion. If answers indicate difficulty covering essentials, accessing care or carrying out daily activities, no paid service is suggested automatically; discuss circumstances first. Wish Making and membership plans are excluded.
en.storage: This browser cannot retain answers. Stay on this page to complete and print.
en.expired: Answers in this tab expired and were cleared. You can start again.
en.loadError: Assessment could not load. Please refresh.
en.accessStep: Your answer mentions difficulty accessing care. Clarify appointment, time, cost, transport or accompaniment needs and look for suitable assistance.
en.awarenessStep: Try one simple word for a feeling, such as sad, tense or angry. It does not need to be exact.
en.copingStep: Recall a method or reliable support that helped feelings settle a little, and start with one feasible step.
en.pressureStep: Your answer mentions continuing beyond capacity. Choose one task to reduce, postpone or ask for help with.
en.worthStep: Your answer links mistakes to personal inadequacy. Separate the task needing adjustment from your judgment of your whole self.
en.chapterLength: 14 questions in this area, spread over 4 short pages.
en.guide: Follow each question’s timeframe and choose the answer closest to your actual experience.
en.smallGap: The gap is descriptive, not evidence of a statistically meaningful difference.
en.supportTitle: Support you could explore with 女兒國
en.supportIntro: Your answers are a starting point. We can talk through what is happening in your life and help you decide what would be useful.
en.reason_iching: Your answers suggest that a decision or putting a plan into practice may be difficult right now. An I Ching Reading is one option for exploring a specific question together.
en.reason_tarot: Your answers suggest there may be a personal question or a sense of direction you would like to explore. Xian Tian Tarot is one option for that conversation.
en.reason_knife: Your answer about waking up rested suggests that rest may need more attention. If you would like a separate body relaxation experience, you could ask us about Knife Therapy. This suggestion does not assess or treat sleep problems.
en.reason_phytoncide: Your answer suggests that your schedule leaves too little time for sleep. Protecting time for sleep comes first. If you would also like a separate relaxation experience, you could ask about Phytoncide Healing; it cannot replace sleep.
en.supportDiscussFirst: We suggest a conversation before choosing a paid service. Your answers mention difficulty with essential expenses, access to care or daily activities; understanding your circumstances comes first.
en.supportNoMatch: This result has no specific service suggestion. You are still welcome to discuss your results or a need the questions did not cover.
en.supportChoice: This is an optional starting point, not a booking or a requirement. Contact us below to discuss whether it suits you before deciding.
en.detailTitle: A closer look at each area
en.purpose: When life is busy, it can be hard to step back. This assessment looks at five areas—wisdom, self-expression, health, resources, and learning and meaning—to help you notice what supports you and what could use more care.
en.durationNote: This is an initial estimate. Your reading and thinking time may vary, so there is no need to rush.
en.whatYouGet: What will you get at the end?
en.outcomeIntro: You will see two charts comparing practical support and inner experience across the five areas, suggested areas to focus on, and small steps you could try. Where relevant, an optional service suggestion can provide a starting point for a conversation with 女兒國.
en.whySeventy: Each area has 14 questions covering everyday actions and inner experience, so you can read your results alongside what is happening in your life.
en.pauseNote: You can take a break. Answers stay in this browser tab for up to 24 hours. Keep this tab open; progress will not transfer to another device.
en.occasionGuide: Count only the occasions when this situation came up.
en.noLogin: No login needed for this trial
